note: RFC 4271 Section 9.1.2 requires re-running Phase 2 Route Selection when either the immediate next-hop or the IGP cost to NEXT_HOP changes. TestIGPCostChangeReselectsWithoutAIGP changes only the Loc-RIB interior metric (10->30->5) and verifies runAIGPSelection moves best A->B->A without BGP UPDATEs; TestRFC4271NextHopLossReselectsAndRestorationRecovers and both internal/forked kernel .ci tests verify cover loss and restoration reselect without UPDATEs; TestRFC4271ImmediateNextHopChangeRepeatsSelection changes only the interior route's immediate next hop with unchanged metric, proving reselection runs against the new immediate hop while keeping the still-reachable BGP route intact.
